Aai Ramai Devi Social Institution, Ghonse

The people behind the promise

Shri. Megeshyam Dattaram Khedekar

Designation: Trustee · विश्वस्त

श्री. मेगाश्याम दत्ताराम खेडेकर

Aai Ramai Devi Social Institution, Ghonse, is the result of the collective thoughts, unity and cooperation of all of us who have come together with the vision of bringing about the social, educational and overall development of our village. Started in the sacred name of Gramdevata Aai Ramai Devi, it is our heartfelt desire that this institution should become a strong platform that supports the weaker and underprivileged sections of society while ensuring that every individual in the village gets an opportunity to participate in the process of development.

As a Trustee, I firmly believe that the foundation of this institution must rest on four fundamental values—trust, transparency, honesty and social responsibility. It is our collective responsibility to ensure that every donation and contribution received by the institution is utilised properly, responsibly and transparently, so that the maximum possible benefit reaches society.

Through this institution, we will make sincere efforts to undertake long-term, sustainable and meaningful work in various fields such as education, healthcare, sports, women and child development, environmental conservation, agriculture, preservation of cultural heritage and social service.

This institution has been established in the name of our revered Gramdevata, Aai Ramai Devi. Therefore, every office-bearer and member is expected to discharge their responsibilities selflessly, honestly and with a spirit of service. The interests, objectives and social responsibilities of the institution must always be given priority over personal differences and individual interests.

Today, we are laying the foundation stone of this institution; however, tomorrow, our work should create a capable, transparent and exemplary social platform for the generations to come. My sincere resolve is that the institution we are building today should not remain limited to our generation, but should become a valuable social legacy for future generations.

With the blessings of Aai Ramai Devi, the cooperation of everyone and our collective unity, may this institution continue to work with dedication for the welfare of society and make a meaningful contribution to the development of Ghonse village. This is my heartfelt prayer and sincere resolve.
